verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim CodeRabbit finds the substantive defects this story asks for: runtime errors, null pointer exceptions, race conditions and logic flaws, using multiple AI models. Independent users partly back this up, including one who says it catches bugs Claude Code misses, a maintainer who calls it the best review tool they've used, and a report of it flagging a critical security risk in a malicious PR. However, one team removed it over verbosity and false positives, which tempers confidence without concretely contradicting the bug-finding capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation or benchmarks on bug-detection accuracy and false-positive rates, and specific hands-on examples of caught race conditions or edge-case bugs.
